scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/shared && npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/server && npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/client
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/shared && npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/server && ELECTRON_BUILD=1 npm run build --workspace=@oto-servis/client
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:desktop && OTO_USE_DIST=1 npm run start --workspace=@oto-servis/electron
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:mac --workspace=@oto-servis/electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:win --workspace=@oto-servis/electron
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:dir --workspace=@oto-servis/electron
